$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the captured pipeline with the four checks that share `tea-evaluate ci --tier pr` rendered as four steps, one per check. The command runs every check of the tier, so the whole tier then runs four times.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean and every command and the upload are present, but `npx tea-evaluate ci --evaluation evals/grader --tier pr` is invoked by four run: blocks where the request asks for each command in a step of its own, so that element misses. Nothing unrequested was added.

elementMisses: command-evaluation-ci-pr: 4 run: blocks invoke npx tea-evaluate ci --evaluation evals/grader --tier pr, expected one
